title: Agri Uma's Studio Cabana Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Kadokawa announced on Wednesday that Agri Uma 's Studio Cabana manga is inspiring a television anime next year. Sayumi Suzushiro plays protagonist Yukari Maki, reprising her role from a 2022 promotional video for the manga.
author: ANN

title: ippatu's Shōjōhime Manga Moves to YanMaga Web on August 2
content: This year's 34th issue of Kodansha 's Young Magazine announced on Tuesday that ippatu 's Shōjōhime (Monkey Princess) manga will move to Kodansha 's YanMaga Web website, where it is simultaneously serialized, on August 2. The manga will also start its new arc in its next chapter.
author: ANN

title: 'Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Akogare no Yume e - Magokoro no Duo' Reveals Additional Cast, Teaser Trailer
content: The official website for the new Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Akogare no Yume e - Magokoro no Duet ( Fairy Princess Minky Momo ) original video anime revealed additional cast members, main visual (pictured), and a teaser trailer on Wednesday.

title: To You in the Beyond Anime Film's Trailer Unveils Theme Song, More Cast
content: The official website for To You in the Beyond , the anime film of Akiko Abe 's Doko Yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e novel, unveiled the full trailer, key visual, theme song artist, and more cast members on Wednesday. The trailer previews the theme song "Olive" by musician Tota .
author: ANN

title: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters Soccer Game's Trailer Introduces South Korean Team
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment revealed a new trailer on Monday for Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters , a new soccer game based on Yōichi Takahashi 's Captain Tsubasa manga, introducing the South Korean team. The game will launch on August 28 for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Mutsumi Aoki Launches New Seinaru Hime no Kakushigoto Manga
content: The September issue of Ichijinsha 's Comic Yuri Hime magazine announced last Thursday that Mutsumi Aoki will launch a new series titled Seinaru Hime no Kakushigoto (The Holy Princess' Secret Affair) in the October issue on August 18.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Blue Lock Film Previews Entrance Exam in New Video
content: The official YouTube channel for the live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga streamed footage of the entrance exam in a new video on Wednesday. The video features the insert song "twilight" by Fukase .
author: ANN
